sources_note: 全部实体取自 Roblox 官方公开接口(S 级),2026-10-10 11:39–11:44 UTC 取:游戏描述与基本字段 games.roblox.com(v1)、通行证 apis.roblox.com/game-passes(4 个,nextPageToken 空串)、开发者商品 apis.roblox.com/developer-products v2(97 个,nextPageCursor=null)、官方活动 virtual-events(带零起点游标 6 条;不带游标 0 条;群组活动接口同样 6 条)、群组 groups.roblox.com、支持语言 gameinternationalization.roblox.com、分级 experience-guidelines-api(POST)。game_version 置 null:Roblox 体验没有版本号,games v1 的 updated(2026-10-08T20:11:58Z)与群组游戏列表 / develop 接口的 updated(2026-08-19T08:54:43Z)是两个值,不作补丁日期。名称逐字复制接口 name / Name 字段(含方括号、# 号、大小写与单复数不一致,如 '3 Karambit Case'、'7 Karambit Cases'、'Cyber Case #2 10'、'[LIMITED] Solar Cannon 115')。4 个通行证的 description 字段全为空串,usage_en 记的是本人看官方图标读到的字(700x700 下载件在 raw/img/);97 个商品的 Description 全为空串,所以没有 description_en / usage_en,key_notes_en 只写本站分组、单价除法、记录创建 / 编辑日。97 个商品共用同一个图标资产 88963008124478(灰色方块占位图),不入图片池。shop_group 与 order 是本站编辑口径,不是官方分类。活动实体的 description_en 把官方 description 的非空行用 ' / ' 拼成一行,逐字未改;页面正文引用游戏描述第 8 行时只引到 'Unlock 70+ weapon skins' 为止(该行括号里的英文原词会被总站 check_content 当成占位语阻塞,原文见 dossier 第 2 节),实体里同样不含那个词。没有徽章实体(badges 接口三次读取均为空)、没有兑换码实体(官方来源 0 个码)、没有逐件武器 / 皮肤实体(官方只给 '70+' 与活动里的 '28 total new weapons',没有名单)。价格为 2026-10-10 快照。
_page_slug_note: page_slug 指向 content/en 下实际存在的页(12 个文件全部 draft: false)。cases / battle-pass / rewards / shop 四页分摊 97 个商品实体。

one-tap.summary_en: Free Roblox sniper free-for-all by the group Stringless Banjo, listed on Roblox as [FPS] One Tap. The official description lists one-shot snipers, two-shot secondaries (one to the head), melee weapons, weapon skins, cases, kill effects, name tags and rewards from levels, daily and quests.
one-tap.description_en: One Tap is a fast-paced FPS sniper FFA arena, no teams, just pure chaos!
one-tap.platforms: Roblox: PC, Mobile, Tablet, Console (Xbox & PlayStation supported), per the official description
one-tap.key_notes_en: 8 players per server · Maturity: Mild (Violence (Repeated/Mild)) · Genre: Shooter, Deathmatch Shooter · 18 supported languages · 4 game passes · 97 developer products · 0 badges · 6 official event listings
one-tap.key_notes_repro: Maturity: POST https://apis.roblox.com/experience-guidelines-api/experience-guidelines/get-age-recommendation with header content-type: application/json and body {"universeId":"9294074907"} returns ageRecommendation.displayName = Mild and one descriptor, Violence (Repeated/Mild) (read 2026-10-10).
one-tap.source_urls_note: The maturity label itself was read from Roblox's experience-guidelines API (see key_notes_source and key_notes_repro). That endpoint only answers POST requests and returns 404 to a plain GET, so it is not listed as a clickable source; the list links Roblox's Creator Hub page on content maturity labels instead (GET 200, read 2026-10-10).
unverified_fields: private_servers (the game page markup carries data-private-server-price="49"; the games API shows createVipServersAllowed: false; not confirmed by a purchase)
platform_support_tested (quoted from the description, not tested per device)

mechanic-weapon-classes.summary_en: The official description gives one line to each of three weapon classes: snipers, secondaries and melee.
mechanic-weapon-classes.key_notes_en: "One-shot snipers" · "Two-Shot Secondaries (One to the head)" · "Melee Weapons"

mechanic-rewards.summary_en: The official description names three reward sources: levels, daily and quests. It does not say what any of them pays.
mechanic-rewards.description_en: Earn rewards from levels, daily, and quests
mechanic-rewards.key_notes_en: Event listings add: "New Level Reward Sniper and Knife" and "Leaderboard Tag and Kill Effect reward for top 100 (Given after reset)" (Update 2, listed from 13 March 2026); "4 New Level Reward Skins" and "Leaderboard prize additions" (Update, listed from 24 April 2026); "Obtain a free kill effect by joining." (Valentines, listed 14 to 15 February 2026)
unverified_fields: whether listed rewards are still obtainable

mechanic-platform-support.summary_en: The official description lists PC, Mobile, Tablet and Console, and adds "(Xbox & PlayStation supported)".
mechanic-platform-support.platforms: PC, Mobile, Tablet, Console (Xbox & PlayStation supported)

mechanic-ban-notice.summary_en: The official description ends with a notice that cheating, exploiting or farming with alts brings a permanent ban.
mechanic-ban-notice.description_en: Cheating, exploiting, or farming with alts will result in a permanent ban. No appeals.
mechanic-ban-notice.key_notes_en: The Update 2 event listing (listed from 13 March 2026) also announces "Reporting players" and "Improved anti-cheat"
unverified_fields: whether any appeal route exists outside the game
